exact_statement: For every nonconstant Boolean source g on a>=1 uniform bits, b>=1 independent padded data bits, r>=1 fresh point controls and every edited point, supply a nonnegative source subprobability R of mass s in(0,1] positive on P_g support and finite c<=C0 I_g,C0>=0. Write n=a+b,p=2^-r,t=2^-n,w=2^-b, F=g-2g(y*)1_controls1_source1_padding, K=4C0+15, C=2pt(n-d),E=2ptd,J=2rpt, with original pivotal degree d. Use the original root floor (Rpad+6pt U_n)/(1+6pt) and its true conditional-control lift. Preserve all preceding v1 padding-prefix conclusions, including L_ell<=(3/2)c+(41/4)I_g and K I(F)-L_ell>=((3/2)C0+1)I_g. After ALL b padding bits are exposed along the unique edited path, query ANY k=1..a original source coordinates on that path in any adaptive order, stopping other branches at their full actual source restrictions. Derive each source restriction reference from ORIGINAL R by physical mass-preserving inheritance Q_j=s(2r_marg*pi_j)/Z_j, with every reference mass s and Z0+Z1=2s; retain zero true fibers and normalized factors Z_j/s. Prescribe the original general envelope based on these source references on the active edited descendants. No child reference is assumed influence-paid. Let L_k=CE_root+sum reach[avg D_child-D_parent]=H(F)+avg D_full_final, including all signed padding/source reset debits and every complementary terminal. For 1<=k<a, L_k<=2(1+w)c+30pt(2a+b+2r-k)<=3c+(45/4)I_g and K I(F)-L_k>=K(C+J)>0. At k=a, use the scalar zero-data floor M_final=(s+6p)/(1+6p)>=s times the actual control spectral law; L_a<=2c+30pt(n+r) and K I(F)-L_a>=C0 I_g+K(C+J)>0. Thus source-changing queries, even with constant source children and unequal spectra, are paid at the SAME original rate, without a renewed source bank. Any EXTRA prior booking0<=U<=U_star=min{(C0+1)I_g,K(C+J)} is paid at root, every padding frontier and every source frontier, leaving the stated respective margin minus U. Optional arbitrary independent terminal references retain full additive CE/KL and multiplied mass. Integer rounding is separate. This does not remove per-edit rate inflation C0->4C0+15 for a NEW representation operation, and does not price arbitrary unrelated off-path resets or prove full FEI.
